io.label: I/O & Boundary
io.description: Read/write dataset boundaries; no semantic optimisation.

structure.label: Structural Transform
structure.description: Shape, schema, and field-interface transforms (skeleton layer).

control.label: Selection & Control
control.description: Filter, dedupe, sample, sort — control which rows flow without redefining semantics.

semantic.label: Semantic (LLM)
semantic.description: LLM actions by output shape: generate, rewrite, extract structure, expand content.

quality.label: Quality & Verification
quality.description: Judgement, scoring, consistency and verification — reports/scores, not mixed transform duties.

bridge.label: Bridge (Evolved)
bridge.description: Task-specific operators synthesized when closure check finds a capability gap (Layer 2).

image.label: Image Processing
image.description: Image quality filtering, face blur, deduplication and normalization.

multimodal.label: Multimodal (VLM)
multimodal.description: Vision-language model operators for image captioning and multimodal QA.
